system.description:
VA 4 (VA 2 for indirect hits from failed tests). Fight actions: Physical Action (light fuse), Throw Object. -1 to the DoF when thrown at extreme range. Lighting the fuse takes two actions with a ready flame; the bomb explodes in the same volley/action of the following exchange. Bombs always suffer +1 Ob to hit. Explosives misfire die: when the fuse is lit roll the DoF; on a 1 it misfires (if built on a failed skill test it detonates immediately, otherwise reroll: 4+ dud, 1-3 explodes next volley). In Range and Cover, a bomb counts as a 1D range weapon with a 30 pace maximum range (see p. 472). Orcs may buy iron-cased bombs for 10 rps.

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 471
